description: This file defines the class CordRepBtree, a C++ implementation of a B-tree structure used internally in the Abseil library for string data management. It includes methods for creating, manipulating, and validating B-tree nodes, as well as internal data structures and algorithms for efficient string handling within a tree structure.

classes.name: CordRepBtree
classes.description: A class implementing a B-tree structure for string data, supporting efficient concatenation, slicing, and validation operations within the Abseil string library.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new CordRepBtree from a given CordRep, converting data edges into a B-tree structure if necessary.

methods.name: Destroy
methods.description: Destroys a CordRepBtree instance, managing internal reference counts.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a CordRep or string data to an existing CordRepBtree, returning the updated tree.

methods.name: Prepend
methods.description: Prepends a CordRep or string data to an existing CordRepBtree, returning the updated tree.

methods.name: SubTree
methods.description: Returns a subtree of the current tree starting at a given offset with specified length.

methods.name: RemoveSuffix
methods.description: Removes a suffix of specified length from the tree.

methods.name: GetCharacter
methods.description: Returns the character at a specific offset within the tree.

methods.name: IsFlat
methods.description: Checks if the tree is a single flat data edge, optionally returning the data fragment.

methods.name: GetAppendBuffer
methods.description: Provides a mutable buffer for appending data to the last flat node, if conditions allow.

methods.name: ExtractAppendBuffer
methods.description: Extracts the rightmost data edge for in-place modification if possible.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new empty or initialized CordRepBtree node.

methods.name: CopyRaw
methods.description: Creates a raw copy of the node with specified length, without referencing existing edges.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Creates a full copy of the node, referencing all edges.

methods.name: CopyBeginTo
methods.description: Creates a copy of the node with edges up to a specified end, with a new length.

methods.name: CopyToEndFrom
methods.description: Creates a copy of the node starting from a specified begin, with a new length.

methods.name: AlignBegin
methods.description: Realigns edges to start at index 0 for appending.

methods.name: AlignEnd
methods.description: Realigns edges to end at capacity for prepending.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an edge or span of edges to the node, realigning as needed.

methods.name: AddData
methods.description: Adds data from a string view to the node, splitting into flats if necessary.

methods.name: SetEdge
methods.description: Replaces the front or back edge with a new edge, unreffing the old.

methods.name: CopyPrefix
methods.description: Returns a partial copy containing the first n bytes.

methods.name: CopySuffix
methods.description: Returns a partial copy containing data after a given offset.

methods.name: ToOpResult
methods.description: Converts the node to an OpResult indicating ownership status.

methods.name: AddCordRep
methods.description: Adds a CordRep to the tree at front or back, returning the updated tree.

methods.name: AddData
methods.description: Adds string data to the tree at front or back, with optional extra capacity.

methods.name: Merge
methods.description: Merges two trees into one, concatenating at front or back.
